languageModelTools.name: axis_run_script
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run the active Pine/PYNE script through AXIS IDE.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run the active Pine/PYNE buffer through AXIS IDE orchestration and return a lastRun summary (status, plotCount, seriesKeys, logCount, diagnosticCount, optional profileMs/hotLines). Use when the user asks to execute, compile, or interpret the open Pine script, or to refresh chart/results after edits. Do NOT use for reading prior run logs (axis_get_run_logs), profiler hot lines (axis_get_profiler), chart symbol/interval (axis_chart_snapshot_meta), or results focus ids without running. Returns summaries only — never full plot/series arrays, never API keys. Requires an active Pine buffer and configured AXIS engine/chart.

mode.description: Execution mode. auto picks interpret vs compile; interpret runs without compile; compile builds then runs.

focus.description: When true (default), publish the run as the focused results entry shown in the Results panel.

languageModelTools.name: axis_get_results_focus
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the focused / newest AXIS run summary.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return resultsFocusId, newestRunId, and lastRunSummary for the AXIS IDE session (plot/series counts and keys, logCount, diagnosticCount, optional profileMs/hotLines — not full arrays). Use when inspecting the latest or focused run outcome without re-running. Do NOT use to execute a script (axis_run_script), fetch runtime log lines (axis_get_run_logs), or get chart symbol/interval (axis_chart_snapshot_meta). Summaries only — no secrets, no plot payloads. Empty session returns null ids/summary.

languageModelTools.name: axis_chart_snapshot_meta
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read seriesKey, interval, and live status for the active AXIS chart.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return seriesKey, interval, optional symbol/exchange/market, scriptIds, and live status for the active AXIS chart document. Use when choosing symbol/timeframe context or checking whether live mode is on. Do NOT use for run results, logs, profiler timings, or plot data. Never returns bars or secrets. Soft-fails when no AXIS chart document is active.

languageModelTools.name: axis_get_run_logs
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read capped runtime logs and diagnostics from the last AXIS run.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return { runId, status, total, rows: { level, message, line }[] } from the last focused AXIS run. Sources match the Logs panel (logs, meta.logs, diagnostics, meta.diagnostics, error). Cap 40 rows; messages are secret-scrubbed. Use when debugging Pine runtime logs, warnings, or compile/runtime errors after a run. Do NOT use for full plot/series data (use axis_get_results_focus / axis_run_script summaries), chart meta, or profiler hot lines (axis_get_profiler). Empty lastRun returns null ids and empty rows.

languageModelTools.name: axis_get_profiler
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read last-run timing and top hot lines from the AXIS profiler.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return { runId, ms, status, engineId, plotCount, seriesCount, profileMs, profileLineCount, hotLines (max 5), phases? } from the last AXIS run and meta.profile. Use when optimizing Pine script performance or asking which lines are slow. Do NOT use for full log text (axis_get_run_logs), plot arrays, or to run a script. Never invents profile lines; empty/missing profile omits or zeros line stats. Secrets scrubbed from error strings.

notes.merge: Merge contributes.languageModelTools into package.json. Call registerLmTools(context, deps) from activate (extension.ts owned by wiring agent). Do not put languageModelTools in mcp-contributes.fragment.json.
notes.secrets: Tools return summaries only — never SecretStorage keys, never full plot/series arrays. axis_run_script uses prepareInvocation confirmation; read-only tools omit confirmationMessages.
notes.deps: Wiring binds runScript → active-editor orchestrator path, results → ResultsFocusStore, getChartSnapshotMeta → active chart doc + live HUD.
